scenario.title: Reusable working rules
situations: The user repeats the same instruction for every item.
A team rule should apply only to one project, workflow or part of the work.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Inspected documented delivery events and intake instruction; no UI interaction or live resolver call performed.
Command nodes, when present, were checked with installed CLI --help only; this proves parser/help availability, not serving-control-plane capability or successful execution.
What exact supported preference record, if any, will JOURNEYS use for a remembered user dismissal?
Do edited execution instructions reach every intended custom workflow/launch consumer in deployed builds?

lessons.title: Put repeated rules in their scoped home
lessons.when: When the user repeats a standing rule or asks that it apply to future work.
lessons.need: Execution instructions can apply before creation, on item reads or when entering selected stage buckets. Scope and delivery are separate choices.
lessons.gap: The editor and delivery mechanism exist, but no repetition-to-reusable-rule cue was found in the reviewed onboarding guidance. Review question: should JOURNEYS add this situation?

lessons.title: Fetch applicable rules before authoring
lessons.when: Before proposing a new item, and again at the existing item-read, claim, launch and stage-entry delivery points.
lessons.need: Resolve before-creation instructions before title/spec proposals; item reads, claims, launches and transitions deliver their applicable instructions later. Do not copy instructions into the item body.
lessons.gap: Review question: should the agent-context map show these outputs as separate context sources so moving docs cannot leave discovery dependent on startup text?
surface_notes: Execution instructions → scoped command results: Before-creation resolver, item reads, claims, launches and stage transitions deliver applicable instructions or their exact full-read command. Do not duplicate that authority in item bodies.
